title: TreeAI D2 verification result
description: Shape of result.json (overall verification run summary, root schema) and of every item in checks.json / results[] (a single check or scenario outcome, $defs/resultItem). Exit-code discipline (frozen for D2, mirrors the D1 2026-09-20 hardening): exit 0 is reserved for PASS. FAIL must carry a non-zero integer exitCode and an error. BLOCKED must carry a reason and must never claim exitCode 0 (null = blocked before the command ran; non-zero integer = the blocked attempt exited non-zero). NOT_RUN must never claim exitCode 0 (null = nothing executed). Revision policy: breaking changes require a schemas/d2/README.md revision entry and new probes under tests/fixtures/schema-probes/result/.

mode.description: offline = verify:d2 (no credentials by design). live = verify:d2:live (controlled credential environment).

driver.description: Live runs only: which runtime driver executed the scenarios (pi | fake).

verdict.description: ALL_PASS = every requested check PASS. HAS_FAIL = at least one FAIL. INCOMPLETE = no FAIL but BLOCKED or NOT_RUN present (the honest Wave 1 state while module owners deliver). VERIFIER_ERROR = the verifier itself failed.

exitCode.description: 0 = all PASS; 1 = verifier error; 2 = at least one FAIL; 3 = no FAIL but BLOCKED/NOT_RUN. Consistency with verdict is enforced by the anyOf below.

notes.description: Redacted free-text notes (e.g. mode semantics explaining absent optional checks).

id.description: Check or scenario id (e.g. typecheck, unit-tests-contracts, live-scenario-steer).

exitCode.description: Exit code of the executed command, if any. Consistency with status is enforced by the anyOf branches below: PASS requires 0; FAIL requires a non-zero integer; BLOCKED/NOT_RUN require null or a non-zero integer, never 0.

evidenceFiles.description: Paths (relative to the run directory) of evidence files this result is traceable to. The verifier asserts the files exist.

error.description: Structured, redacted error. Required for FAIL.

reason.description: Human-readable, redacted reason. Required for BLOCKED and NOT_RUN (an unexecuted check must never look like a pass).

detail.description: Redacted supplementary detail (summary line of a command, counts, etc.).

scenarioResult.description: A live-scenario result item (verify:d2:live). Extends resultItem with live-specific required fields. scenario ids are frozen from the D1/D2 shared contract: tree-navigation is the canonical name (D1 DECISION-009).

piVersion.description: Must equal the D2 pinned Pi version (PinnedPiVersion in the frozen contracts).

code.description: Prefer a frozen TreeAIErrorCode (auth | model-unavailable | user-abort | timeout | policy-denied | upstream | session-corrupt | unknown) for runtime failures; other short machine codes are allowed for verifier-internal failures.
